work_title: Under the Mannen Bridge at Fukagawa

places.name: Katsushika
places.connection: Katsushika is the birthplace of Katsushika Hokusai, the artist of Under the Mannen Bridge at Fukagawa.

places.name: Edo (now Tokyo)
places.connection: Edo, now Tokyo, is where Hokusai created many of his works, including Under the Mannen Bridge at Fukagawa.

places.name: The British Museum
places.connection: The British Museum holds a collection of Hokusai's works, including Under the Mannen Bridge at Fukagawa.

places.name: Sumida River
places.connection: The Sumida River is depicted in the artwork Under the Mannen Bridge at Fukagawa.
